CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to an identified content's organization/access in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its presentation (coordinates as the manner of presentation) and a separate status/origin are all explicitly stated for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to a content's organization/presentation/access; 'candidate' listings do not explicitly state an attention relation.

C.rationale: The report identifies specific represented content (red at coordinate (0,2)) for a named current referent.

D.rationale: The origin/status for the same identified content is separately recorded (history_estimate), distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: Content presentation is given by explicit coordinate listings and an explicit grid layout statement describing how content is organized/presented.
